cd:SessionEndEvidenceShape: "Basis and quality of session finalization, allowing physical or administrative closure to be distinguished."
cd:SessionEventShape: "Ordered lifecycle evidence for a canonical session, with a source envelope."
cd:SessionLimitPolicyShape: "Limits on charging start or continuation with an explicit enforcement outcome."
cd:SessionPricingPolicyShape: "Session-wide floor, ceiling, fee eligibility and ordered component evaluation policy."
cd:SettlementApprovalShape: "Explicit release decision for partner settlement, including reconciliation, approver, payee and liability for unresolved differences."
cd:SettlementBatchShape: "Partner receivable/payable reconciliation over a defined period and currency."
cd:SettlementItemShape: "Individual charge or adjustment attributed under a contract."
cd:SettlementOverrideShape: "Time-scoped exception to a contract settlement rule with authorization evidence."
cd:SharingAgreementShape: "Time-limited sharing of an asset with an account or partner, preserving ownership."
cd:SharingInvitationShape: "Invitation to accept asset access; stores a secret reference rather than an invitation token."
cd:SignedMeterEvidenceShape: "Cryptographically signed metering evidence with signing identity and verification result."
cd:SiteAccessPolicyShape: "Rules for physical or service access, independent of map visibility."
cd:SmartChargingPreferenceShape: "Customer charging objective including deadline, target energy and randomized-delay preference."
cd:SourceEventShape: "Immutable source envelope identifying event time, receipt time, producer and retained payload."
cd:StateTransitionShape: "Recorded transition between controlled states with policy and source evidence."
cd:SubscriptionBillingPolicyShape: "Subscription fee accumulation, renewal and personal-charger multipliers independent of the service allowance."
cd:SubscriptionPlanShape: "Versioned recurring commercial plan with charging benefits and billing policy."
cd:SubscriptionShape: "Customer enrollment in a plan with explicit renewal and cancellation semantics."
cd:SubsidyRuleShape: "Externally funded reduction with a beneficiary, policy version and optional integration authority."
cd:SynchronizationCursorShape: "Checkpoint of a partner stream retaining negotiated ordering and freshness semantics."
cd:TariffAssignmentShape: "Membership of a tariff version in a selection set, with explicit priority."
cd:TariffResolutionShape: "Recorded result of price selection, including input evidence and resolver version."
cd:TariffSetShape: "Ordered candidate selection policy, with explicit default and offline pricing."
cd:TariffShape: "Stable identity of a commercial pricing offer whose versions hold the immutable terms."
cd:TariffVersionShape: "Immutable price definition including effective window, currency and component rules."
cd:TaxDeterminationShape: "Recorded tax treatment and evidential facts for a supply or billing line."
cd:TaxIdentifierShape: "Tax registration identifier qualified by issuing jurisdiction and identifier type."
cd:TaxRuleShape: "Versioned tax rule selected by jurisdiction and supply context; not a global VAT default."
cd:TemplateApplicationShape: "Auditable attempt to apply a configuration template to a station."
cd:TemporalCommitShape: "Immutable recorded-time revision of a complete effective-time map for one tenant and coherent validation scope. System end is derived from its successor commit."
cd:TemporalSliceShape: "Half-open business-time slice selecting one immutable RDF payload graph or an explicit retraction. It belongs to a commit and cannot overlap its sibling slices."
cd:TemporalSnapshotSelectionShape: "Evidence of a valid-time and known-time selection inside one committed scope; queries use only its selected graph and the recorded schema version."
cd:TemporalStreamPolicyShape: "Explicit policy for event-time disorder and corrections. Beyond-retention evidence is quarantined, and historical payloads are preserved by the reference writer."
cd:TenantShape: "Administrative data-isolation boundary, independent of legal entities and brands."
cd:TimeWindowShape: "Half-open UTC interval with an inclusive start and exclusive end."
cd:TopUpOfferShape: "Purchase offer for funding a wallet, separating purchase price and credited value."
cd:UnmanagedLoadObservationShape: "Measured or estimated non-controlled load used for site allocation."
cd:UsageAggregateShape: "Reproducible time-bucketed usage with direction and aggregation policy."
cd:UserDeviceShape: "Client-device registration using an opaque push or device reference."
cd:VehicleAssignmentShape: "Time-qualified access of a customer account to a vehicle."
cd:VehicleShape: "Vehicle reference with technical data and controlled identity information."
cd:VehicleTelemetryShape: "Timestamped vehicle values with provenance and units fixed by property names."
cd:VendorFaultDefinitionShape: "Vendor-scoped fault meaning, severity and recommended customer or operator response."
cd:VoucherRedemptionShape: "Recorded application of voucher value to a customer's wallet."
cd:VoucherShape: "Monetary redemption instrument with opaque code reference and finite redemption terms."
cd:WalletEntryShape: "Signed customer balance movement linked to immutable journal evidence."
cd:WalletShape: "Customer monetary balance projection, backed by immutable ledger entries."
cd:WorkOrderShape: "Accountable maintenance assignment with scope, provider and completion evidence."
